data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 (rubric for homogenized school-to-seat) reduces to SRC_001 (frozen lease drift mutation): the rubric form in SRC_003 can be reduced to a program eval by instantiating a minimal fixture with school and seat mismatched under the same school ID, asserting coverage fails under the mutation. The reduction is refuted if the rubric evaluates a declarative coverage property that cannot be verified by program execution on a minimal fixture, or if the school-to-seat binding requires a topology representation that violates the frozen-lease constraint.
